anti_overlap: fd-loop-mechanics covers the structural OODARC mapping of execution primitives (init/run/log)
fd-flywheel-integration covers whether experiment outcomes feed the Interspect evidence pipeline
fd-implementation-path covers pillar ownership of the implementation
decision_lens: Findings matter most when they identify either a gap in Demarch's OODARC Orient phase that autoresearch's living-document pattern would fill, or a duplication where autoresearch's memory pattern would create a parallel store conflicting with an existing memory category. Novel contributions to the cross-session loop rank highest.
focus: Whether the autoresearch pattern's Orient and Compound phases (living document, ideas backlog, fresh-agent resumability) address the identified gaps in Demarch's OODARC Orient and Compound legs across all four loop timescales
name: fd-oodarc-orient-gaps
persona: A cognitive architecture researcher focused on agent orientation quality and knowledge compounding. Evaluates how the autoresearch 'institutional memory' patterns compare to and complement Demarch's existing Orient primitives and Compound mechanisms.
review_areas: Compare autoresearch.md (living document) against the situation assessment schema proposed in the OODARC brainstorm — does it provide a richer Orient input for the cross-session loop
Evaluate the ideas backlog as a mechanism for the Compound leg of the cross-session OODARC loop
Assess whether the 'fresh agent continuity guarantee' addresses the per-turn Orient gap ('no unified snapshot') or only the cross-session gap
Check whether secondary metrics consistency enforcement is an instance of the 'Defaults become fallback' closed-loop pattern from PHILOSOPHY.md
Identify whether the segment model is better or worse than Demarch's existing run/phase/sprint scoping for multi-campaign experiment history
Evaluate whether the living-document pattern in Clavain's reflect phase would close the 'Reflect only at sprint end' gap in Sprint OODARC
success_hints: The autoresearch.md pattern provides a concrete template for structured situation assessment that the OODARC brainstorm calls for
The ideas backlog addresses the cross-session Compound gap with a simpler mechanism than the full ModelStore interface
The pattern complements rather than duplicates Demarch's existing C4/C5 memory categories
task_context: pi-autoresearch is an autonomous experiment loop for the pi agent platform, assessed as 'inspire-only' for Demarch. This review evaluates which design patterns are worth porting as a Demarch-native autoresearch capability and how they integrate with the OODARC framework, flywheel mechanics, and Interspect evidence pipeline.
